definitions.gloss: emergency bell; alarm bell; emergency alarm
definitions.explanation: An alarm bell or buzzer installed in buildings, trains, and other facilities that is activated in case of emergency such as fire, earthquake, or crime.

examples.japanese: {非常|ひじょう}ベルが{鳴|な}った。
{非常|ひじょう}ベルを{押|お}してください。
{火災|かさい}{訓練|くんれん}で{非常|ひじょう}ベルが{鳴|な}ったので、{全員|ぜんいん}{避難|ひなん}した。
examples.english: The emergency bell rang during the fire drill, so everyone evacuated.

notes:
Found in buildings, train stations, and on trains throughout Japan. On trains, it is often labeled {非常|ひじょう}ボタン (emergency button) rather than {非常|ひじょう}ベル.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常|ひじょう}ベルが{鳴|な}る — the emergency bell rings
- {非常|ひじょう}ベルを{押|お}す — to press the emergency alarm
- {非常|ひじょう}ベルを{鳴|な}らす — to sound the emergency alarm

RELATED TERMS:
- {非常口|ひじょうぐち} — emergency exit
- {火災報知器|かさいほうちき} — fire alarm
- {非常|ひじょう}ボタン — emergency button
- {防犯|ぼうはん}ブザー — personal safety buzzer
